source_status: Liu arXiv:2509.02950v1 is unrefereed; only the M_{5,8} half is used

claims.statement: Over C, A^*(U_8) is tautological and U_8 has CKgP, after descent from the mu_5-gerbe M'_{5,8} by Canning-Larson Lemma 3.6.
The class [M_omega] is tautological of codimension 4 in M_{5,8} minus M^3_{5,8} by Porteous; the displayed degree-4 formula is the class used.
Normalized sequence (10) gives c(G)=c(L^vee tensor f_* omega_f); with c_1(L)=2 psi_i on M_omega this proves Liu Corollary 3.6.
BGL_4 -> BG is a representable A^4-bundle, so Canning-Larson Lemma 3.5 gives CKgP of BG from CKgP of BGL_4.
Liu Proposition 3.3 is an open immersion: the inverse sends a net cutting out a smooth complete intersection C to (C, p1,...,p7, p8) with p8 residual on C cap H.
A^*(M_omega) is generated by restrictions of tautological classes, and M_omega has CKgP.
Canning-Larson Lemma 9.9 applies at g=5, n=8 (n=8 <= g+7=12) and supplies CKgP of M^3_{5,8} together with tautologicality of classes supported on it.
Excision and Canning-Larson Lemma 3.4 glue L1, L6, L7 to A^*(M_{5,8})=R^*(M_{5,8}) and CKgP of M_{5,8}.
CLP Lemma 4.3 plus L8 plus Ionel Theorem 0.1 at codimension 12 give W_24 H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)=0.
